body: TASK J8 is assigned: research/TASK_J8.md. Research only, top tier / effort high / Fast off, one delivery. Four areas: demand drivers for a combat gym (gym fame, a famous athlete on the roster, the coach), equipment as attraction vs capacity, location and market saturation tied to the creation country/city/gym screen, and the shape of the number (churn, ceiling). Decisions N1-Nn. Hard constraints unchanged: J5 G24 no sport-wide dollar without evidence, J4 E3 / J5 G10 no gym_cut, J5 G9 no default percentage. Deliverable research/J8_*.md plus CLAUDE_LAND_NOTE_J8.md; do not edit HANDOFF.md.
